channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Dow tumbles 700 points, S&P 500 falls as Treasury plan to subdue yields fails
item.description: U.S. stocks fell on Thursday as Treasury yields reversed course from the decline seen in the prior trading day.

item.title: Walmart stock tumbles 9% after outlook disappoints Wall Street
item.description: Walmart is expected to report its fiscal second-quarter earnings on Thursday, offering a read on the consumer and the K-shaped economy.

item.title: Bessent's efforts in the Treasury market so far haven't worked. Here's what else he can try
item.description: Market experts showed skepticism at whether the push would succeed against a bevy of factors working against Treasurys.

item.title: AI data center outrage is showing up everywhere from ads to elections
item.description: With less than three months until the midterm elections, opposition to AI data centers is becoming a bipartisan rallying cry in a growing number of states.

item.title: Warsh faces Fed independence test as Bessent moves in on central bank's turf
item.description: Bessent’s effort to tamp down long-term Treasury yields could force Warsh to clarify how far the Fed should go in coordinating on bonds and the balance sheet.

item.title: Wall Street loves these high-yielding AI bonds. What income investors should know
item.description: Investors can grab sweet yields from hyperscaler bonds. Issuance has surged as the companies look to fund their artificial intelligence buildout.

item.title: Hyundai considering U.S. production increase at new Georgia plant, CEO tells CNBC
item.description: The potential capacity increase would be part of Hyundai's plan to invest $26 billion in the U.S. through 2028, Hyundai CEO José Muñoz told CNBC.

item.title: California AG tells CNBC that settling Paramount-WBD lawsuit would require 'robust structural remedies'
item.description: California AG Rob Bonta discussed the states' antitrust case to block the Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger with CNBC's David Faber.

item.title: Bessent says U.S. likely won't restart large-scale Iran combat as it steps up economic pressure
item.description: Bessent and President Donald Trump unveiled the economic operation nearly six months into the Iran war, which continues without a clear end in sight.

item.title: How Micron's $50 billion Boise buildout is reshaping its hometown
item.description: Micron's AI-fueled rise and expansion are creating jobs and wealth in Boise, Idaho, while adding pressure to housing, traffic and the city's identity.

item.title: Arctos agrees to buy 10% of Atlanta Falcons at $10.6 billion valuation, sources say
item.description: Private equity firm Arctos has agreed to buy 10% of the Atlanta Falcons in a deal with an enterprise value of $10.6 billion, two sources told CNBC.

item.title: The Los Angeles Lakers sold for $12.5 billion. Here’s what every NBA team is now worth
item.description: The pending $12.5 billion Lakers sale would lift CNBC’s average NBA team valuation 21% to $6.68 billion, with the Warriors still No. 1.

item.title: Call-buying bonanza around Trump's Hyperliquid comments includes some eyebrow-raising trades
item.description: President Donald Trump hinted that regulation may be in the works for Hyperliquid. Interesting trading activity followed.

item.title: Education Department recalculates student loan forgiveness counts, setting some PSLF borrowers back
item.description: Many borrowers pursuing Public Service Loan Forgiveness have recently learned that they're further away from debt cancellation than they'd expected.

item.title: Bessent says there's a 'very good chance' U.S. budget deficit under Trump has peaked
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Thursday that there's a "very good chance" of the U.S. has seen its budget deficit peak under President Donald Trump.

item.title: Bitcoin surges 12% in two days as Trump, crypto execs lead last ditch effort for Clarity Act
item.description: Bitcoin is trading at its highest levels since early June as crypto execs joined with President Donald Trump push to get the Clarity Act over the finish line.

item.title: Where commercial real estate demand is the highest, according to new data
item.description: The National Association of Realtors has released a new index that uses factors in local economies to indicate future demand.

item.title: Yields are on the move once again. These stocks could get a boost if they keep going higher
item.description: Using LSEG data, CNBC Pro screened the S&P 1500 for stocks with the strongest negative 60-day correlations to the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF (TLT).

item.title: Hyundai's new flagship vehicle is a large luxury Genesis EV
item.description: The GV90 features a new design direction for Genesis and expands the Hyundai brand's lineup to seven vehicles in the U.S.

item.title: Gatekeeping bots, piles of slop: Welcome to the age of AI weirdness at work
item.description: AI has changed jobs and businesses, but it's also creating bottlenecks, confusion and downright awkward encounters for humans in the workplace.

item.title: A rare stumble at TJX has Wall Street spooked. We see a buying opportunity
item.description: We trust the off-price retailer is already fixing its problems.

item.title: Buying an Apple product? These 4 tools can help you pay for it
item.description: With some Apple products seeing price hikes, CNBC Select goes over some of the best ways to finance Apple products and who could benefit the most.

item.title: Treasury proposes low-cost investment rules for Trump Accounts
item.description: The Treasury Department has issued new Trump Account guidance, emphasizing low-cost investments.

item.title: U.S. sports fans spend about $2,000 a year on their favorite teams—many find themselves in debt as a result
item.description: As football season approaches, many Americans are planning to take on debt to pay for tickets, memorabilia, parlays and more.

item.title: Alibaba shares fall 5% as AI spending drives 75% drop in net income
item.description: Alibaba's U.S. listed shares were volatile in premarket trading after posting a 75% drop in net income in the June quarter.

item.title: A household appliance maker made it into Josh Brown's Best Stocks list this month. It is soaring in 2026
item.description: This stock has been on a tear since being spun off in 2023.

item.title: How wealthy families can prepare for aging parents and avoid a succession crisis
item.description: Relatively few wealthy families are addressing the question of when an aging parent should give up control, advisors and lawyers told CNBC.

item.title: Oil prices rise after Treasury Secretary says U.S. will collapse Iran with economic pressure
item.description: Oil moved higher Thursday after U.S. President Donald Trump sharpened his rhetoric against Iran.

item.title: U.S. government debt passes $40 trillion, more than doubling in a decade
Trump touted a deal to avert new tariffs on Canada. Here's what we know so far
item.description: Trump's new tariffs on about $20 billion worth of Canadian goods were set to take effect Wednesday, but were postponed by three days.
